rules.text: Inbound and outbound share the account/API-key concurrency budget. Read max_concurrent for the effective limit.
rules.why: Each number draws from the same account capacity.

rules.text: There is no per-number concurrent-call reservation.
rules.instead: Queue or pace each tenant in your application. Use separate accounts if the budgets must be independent.

rules.text: Distinguish a rejected request, an accepted operation and an unknown outcome. Inspect the error code and details before deciding whether to retry.
Adjust the rate at which your application submits work. An accepted queue entry can still wait for capacity.
The default is [[lim-default]] simultaneous calls when the account has no positive override.
Inspect account usage for current capacity information.
On rate_limit_exceeded use retry_after_seconds. For an uncertain send, reconcile its receipt before submitting anything again.
